== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Noroloth is an ancient [[Black dragons|black dragon]] [[Herald]] and the son of an emperor. Historically, he was involved in a bitter rivalry with a rune-using [[Sage]]; after she used a deceptive [[elixirs|elixir]] to [[poison]] his eldest son and prevent him from producing more offspring, he retaliated by burning her [[library]]. In his current state, Noroloth exists as a [[Remnant]], appearing as a large black-and-red [[spirit]]. He has experienced madness and has been known to hide his presence by mimicking [[Wind aura|wind aura]] or holding his breath. Despite his past, the [[Remnant]] has provided assistance in combat, such as managing explosive forces to protect a cavern and attempting to aid others in battle. He has also acted as an instructor, offering guidance to those studying the [[Path of Black Flame]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Noroloth is a [[Black dragons|black dragon]] prince. His tail has the quality of dissolving into smoke.}}
